mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id, n.member_id, n.notification_type, n.title, n.message, n.related_id, n.event_date, n.is_read, n.read_at, n.created_at, m.email FROM notifications n JOIN member m ON n.member_id = m.member_id WHERE m.email = #{userId} AND (n.event_date IS NULL OR n.event_date <= CURDATE()) AND n.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications n JOIN member m ON n.member_id = m.member_id SET n.is_read = true, n.read_at = NOW() WHERE m.email = #{userId} AND n.is_read = false
UPDATE notifications SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId}
UPDATE notifications SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = (SELECT member_id FROM member WHERE email = #{userId}) AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n JOIN member m ON n.member_id = m.member_id WHERE m.email = #{userId} AND n.is_read = false AND (n.event_date IS NULL OR n.event_date <= CURDATE()) AND n.deleted_at IS NULL
